GSEA Results: CD14+ Monocytes vs Others (PBMC 3K)

Source: R/data.R
gsea_pbmc3k.Rd

GSEA results from comparing Cluster 2 (>97% CD14+ Monocytes) against all other clusters in the pbmc3k dataset. Generated via clusterProfiler::gseGO() using biological process ontology on a ranked gene list from Wilcoxon differential expression analysis.

Usage

gsea_pbmc3k

Format

A gseaResult object from clusterProfiler with slots:

result

data.frame with columns: ID, Description, setSize, enrichmentScore, NES, pvalue, p.adjust, qvalue, rank, leading_edge, core_enrichment

Source

Differential expression (Cluster 2 vs others) on pbmc3k dataset, GSEA via clusterProfiler::gseGO(ont = "BP").

Examples

data(gsea_pbmc3k)
gsea_pbmc3k
